# Sketchi Icons

Sketchi Icons is a public library of SVG icons for people and software agents.
The browser is available at https://icons.sketchi.app/.
All API responses allow cross-origin reads.

## Search

GET /api/icons?q=k8s&collection=&limit=20
Search ranks exact slugs, name prefixes, aliases, substrings, then collections.
The response includes public slugs, names, collections, keywords, and URLs.
The limit defaults to 50 and is capped at 100.

Each icon has a colorMode: mono-dark or mono-light (one neutral ink) or
multicolor (brand colors). onDark and onLight say what keeps a mark visible on
a background it would vanish into: invert for a neutral mark, or a neutral
plate behind a multicolor one, whose colors are never changed.

## Get one icon

GET /api/icons/kubernetes
Returns metadata plus the full SVG source in the svg field.

GET /api/icons/kubernetes.svg
Returns only the raw SVG with Content-Type: image/svg+xml.
Use this endpoint when you only need the icon file.

Public slugs are stable and unique.
When source collections contain the same raw slug, one keeps the short slug.
Other icons receive a collection-qualified slug returned by search.

## Hand-drawn marks

Most catalog marks also have a hand-drawn version: a recipe of a few drawing
parts on a 24-unit grid, the same form as community icons. Diagrams draw a
node's logo from it unless they ask for exact marks.

GET /icon-drawings.json
Every hand-drawn recipe, keyed by catalog slug. A slug that is missing has no
drawing yet.

GET /sketchi-icons.excalidrawlib
The same drawings as one Excalidraw library, one item per mark, named after
the product.

## Packs

Smaller libraries by subject: palantir, ai-models, ai-tools, cloud, data,
devtools and languages. GET /packs/index.json lists every pack with its count.

GET /packs/palantir.excalidrawlib
The pack as an Excalidraw library.

GET /packs/palantir.excalidraw
The pack as an Excalidraw scene, each drawing named underneath; all.excalidraw
holds the whole catalog. excalidraw.com opens one from
https://excalidraw.com/#url=<encoded scene URL>.

## Community icons

Hand-drawn icons anyone publishes, kept apart from the catalog.
Each is a recipe of a few drawing parts on a 24-unit grid, not an SVG.
Its slug is community/<name>; a diagram node's icon takes that slug.

GET /api/community?q=queue&limit=60&cursor=
Newest first; q matches names and slugs. Pass nextCursor back as cursor.

GET /api/community/ring-queue
Returns the name, slug, recipe and colors.

POST /api/community
Body: { "name": "Ring queue", "recipe": { "parts": [...] }, "verdict"?: {...} }
Returns 201 with the slug and page URL, or 200 with the existing icon when
the same recipe is already published. Names and recipe text are moderated
(422 when rejected), and each address may publish 10 icons a minute (429).
A word too large for the 24-unit grid would be cut off, so it is refused
with 422 and code recipe_clips, naming the word.

## MCP

Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to /mcp.
Tool search_icons accepts q, collection, and limit.
Tool get_icon accepts an exact slug and returns raw SVG first.

Example: search for psql, then call get_icon with postgresql.
Example: search for next, then fetch /api/icons/nextjs.svg.
